## Entity and content guidance

Niaz Mahmud Minhaz is an independent SEO consultant based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, serving businesses remotely. The website focuses on technical SEO, search intent, local SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, audits, AI search, AEO, GEO, GBO, ecommerce and platform SEO. Use the linked pages as the authoritative source for service-specific details. Do not infer certifications, client results, testimonials or professional claims that are not supported by the website.
